operator: Kimi K3 KDA fwd+bwd, hip_kda G2 (R5 tree), K=V=128, chunk 64, bf16

groups.what: l2norm + gate + intra-chunk Aqk/Akk, (I+A)^-1, W/U natives
forward state recurrence fused with output o

serial.note: per chunk step the state h_i -> h_{i+1} dependency. chain (current dataflow): LDS read of h, 8 dependent MMACs (v_new = U - W h, K=128 reduction), LDS write+barrier of v_new, 4 dependent MMACs (K^T v_new), LDS write+barrier of h. chain_min (dependency only): one cross-lane exchange of the state and two MMAC levels (both GEMMs with a tree reduction); barriers and the serial K-reduction are implementation choices and are dropped, so this stays a valid lower bound for any dataflow that keeps the chunk algorithm.

groups.what: recompute W/U and all P2/P3 operand layouts
backward recompute of the forward recurrence (emits h, v_new)

serial.note: dh_i -> dh_{i-1}: 8 dependent MMACs (K dh), LDS write+barrier of dv2, 4 dependent MMACs (q dO - W dv2), LDS write+barrier of dh (g2_engine.cuh g2_dhu_v8b_kernel)

groups.what: chunk-parallel dq/dk/dv/dg/db (wy + intra fused, split in two kernels)

flops.note: MODEL FLOPs of the chunked KDA algorithm (chunk C=64, K=V=128), per chunk and head in MACs: intra-chunk Akk, Aqk, w = A(k beta g), u = A(v beta) -> 4 C^2 K; UT inverse C^3/3; recurrence v_new = u - w h, o_inter = q_g h, h += k_g^T v_new -> 3 C K V; o_intra = Aqk v_new -> C^2 V. Dense C x C blocks (the causal half is not discounted).  Backward = 2x forward (the usual MFU convention, PaLM appendix B); recompute and padding are NOT model FLOPs (they appear in HFU).
